name: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Extender
tagline: WALL EXTENDER FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOF PLANTING TRAY
summary: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Extender is a wall extender designed to increase the wall height of an extensive green roof planting tray to increase the soil capacity of each tray. Wall extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and slot into the trays connecting at 90º angles to each wall extender. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 Wall Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG, SikaRoof® VersiDrain® MEP and SikaRoof® VersiDrain® 60 trays to increase the soil capacity of these trays enabling more diverse planting options.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Products must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements
